lib/providers/export_provider.dart.description: Added exportDirectoryProvider StateProvider<String?> to store selected export directory path for use during export operations

lib/providers/groups_provider.dart.description: GroupsNotifier now tracks last created group with _lastCreatedGroupId field and provides undoLastGroup() method that removes the group from state and calls markAsUngrouped() on the images provider

lib/providers/images_provider.dart.description: ImportedImagesNotifier now has index-based selection methods (selectImageAt, deselectImageAt) and markAsUngrouped for undo functionality. These enable keyboard-driven selection workflow in GroupingScreen.

lib/screens/grouping_screen.dart.description: _SelectableThumbnail widget now accepts isCursor parameter for visual keyboard navigation indicator. Cursor shows amber border with glowing box shadow effect, distinct from blue selection border.
